long_biography.plain_text:
Rehabilitation became the Michels family's defining business after Kurt Michels redirected the sanitation and heating company he had taken over from his father into building and operating clinics. His son Kurt-Josef joined the group after university and helped convert a former sanatorium near Bernau into Brandenburgklinik, anchoring a wider healthcare campus after German reunification.

Management passed to Kurt-Josef and his brother Kai-Uwe around the start of the new century. They expanded across neurological, orthopaedic, geriatric, cardiological and psychosomatic rehabilitation, connecting clinics with care facilities and training. Kurt-Josef remains the holding company's board chairman and manager of several operating entities while transferring frontline leadership to a fourth family generation.

Sylt is a popular holiday destination in the Wadden area of northern Germany. Kurt-Josef Michels lives there and owns a chain of hotels together with his brother Josef-Uwe Michels. The family group, named Michels Hotels, owns and operates eight hotels in Germany. Five of them are located in Norderney, two on the island of Sylt and the last one is situated in Berlin. 

Mr. Michels previously owned another Sanlorenzo by the same name. Built to the SL78 range and delivered in 2021, Regine was sold in March 2022 with a last known asking price of €3,700,000. Philippe Blattès of Sanlorenzo France represented the seller.
